name: web3-vanilla-wagmi-login
description: Wealth Wards – Web3 desktop and web app with Sign-In With Ethereum
author: Wealth Wards

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-dashboard.mjs && concurrently "vite" "node server.js" "npm run dev:dashboard-watch"
scripts.dev:dashboard-watch: cd WW-Dash && cross-env BASE_URL=/dashboard/ npx vite build --watch --outDir ../dist/dashboard
scripts.build:dashboard: cd WW-Dash && BASE_URL=/dashboard/ npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist/dashboard && cp -r WW-Dash/dist dist/dashboard
scripts.build:dashboard:electron: cd WW-Dash && BASE_URL=./ npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist/dashboard && cp -r WW-Dash/dist dist/dashboard
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "vite" "node server.js" "wait-on http://localhost:5173/app/ && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.dist: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=1 node --max-old-space-size=8192 ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && npm run build:dashboard:electron && electron-builder
